description.p: SenatorialNotes is a native Linux notes application that keeps ordinary Markdown files on your device. It has no accounts, cloud service, telemetry, analytics, advertising, or runtime networking.

It provides local vault creation, a Markdown editor with live visual styling, atomic autosave, Trash and restore, nested notebooks, tags and tag filtering, Archive, Pinned and Recently Edited views, user-controlled sorting, a Note Information panel, appearance preferences, and optional individually encrypted notes. More note-management features are planned before 1.0.
The editor styles Markdown visually while keeping Markdown as the format on disk. Syntax markers stay visible but subdued rather than hidden; it is not a full WYSIWYG editor.

ul.li: Nested notebooks with safe create, rename, and delete.
Note movement between notebooks, including encrypted notes.
Tags and tag filtering, Archive, Pinned and Recently Edited views.
User-controlled sorting and composed notebook, tag, and search filtering.
A Note Information panel and keyboard-navigation improvements.
Editor V2 live visual Markdown styling; markers stay visible but subdued.
